  weight: 0.7

  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal

    - 0.15

    orientation:

      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.2
      default: 0.15
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.z
        mode: replace

  - id: collision_avoid
    when: during_phase
    predicate: force_below
    threshold: 2.0
    on_failure: retry
  retries:
    max_attempts: 2
    strategy: offset_target
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.05
    - 0.0

      default: 0.1
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
    align_z:
      type: scalar
      range:

      - 0.1
      default: 0.05
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.z

  subtask_id: final_goal

  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    offset:

    - 0.0
    - 0.0

    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
